title: Naturality of the supplied normalized tensor isomorphism on actual signed totals
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X→Y, commutative ring sheaves R,S and c:f^{-1}R≅S [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], put A=f^{-1}R and U=Res_c. Let Tot_S and Tot_A be the signed direct-sum total tensor functors on module cochain complexes [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model]. Given normalized RingIsoTensorTransport data o for c [lem-sfb-ring-isomorphism-tensor-transport], the components o.totalIso(P,Q):U_Ch(Tot_S(P,Q))≅Tot_A(U_Ch P,U_Ch Q) are natural on the product category of cochain complexes: U_Ch(Tot_S(v,w));o.totalIso(P′,Q′).hom=o.totalIso(P,Q).hom;Tot_A(U_Ch v,U_Ch w). This is the existing tensorIso_naturality declaration, relocated and proved using the generic total-map formula.

source.place: Tag 07A4, signed-total tensor convention; the actual component and normalization data are the existing RingIsoTensorTransport.totalIso, total_naturality and total_summand fields.

proof.text: The generic mapTotalBifunctor formula identifies the map of the uncurried signed-total functor at an arbitrary product morphism with the totalized bifunctor map. For the curried tensor bifunctor this is the tensor of chain maps, so the given total_naturality field of o proves the equation. This is a naturality assertion about the supplied components and constructs no new data.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorIso_naturality (o : SheafOfModules.RingIsoTensorTransport
    (J := ProEt.topology X)
    (R := (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R) (S := S) c)
    (Z W : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules X S) ℤ ×
      CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules X S) ℤ) (v : Z ⟶ W) :
    (total X S ⋙ (pbcRestrict c.hom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map v ≫
        (o.totalIso W.1 W.2).hom =
      (o.totalIso Z.1 Z.2).hom ≫
        (((pbcRestrict c.hom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod
          ((pbcRestrict c.hom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⋙
            total X ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R)).map v
